comment: Frame 007: the title page of the 1926 edition, in calligraphy, on the white paper of the text.

lines.text: من المدن والجبال والبحار والجزائر والأنهار
lines.plain: من المدن والجبال والبحار والجزائر والأنهار

lines.plain: استخرجه أبو جعفر محمّد بن موسى الخوارزمىّ

lines.text: من كتاب جغرافيا الّذى ألّفه بطلميوس القلوذىّ
lines.plain: من كتاب جغرافيا الّذى ألّفه بطلميوس القلوذىّ

observations: The title page is written in calligraphy and printed from a block. Its lines are transcribed with the words divided as usual, since the calligraphy sets them close and lets them overlap; hamza and shadda are transcribed where they are written (الأرض, والأنهار, أبو, محمّد, الخوارزمىّ, الّذى, ألّفه, القلوذىّ, آدولف). The other vowel signs of the calligraphy (a ḍamma over the ب of كتاب and the ص of صورة, over the ه of استخرجه, ألّفه, بنسخه and تصحيحه, a fatḥa over the ع of طبع and the م of مدينة, a kasra under the alif of استخرجه and the س of سنة) and its small v-shaped signs over and under letters are not transcribed. The editor's name is written مژيك, with ژ, three dots over the ز, for the ž of Mžik, and Vienna ڤينا, with ڤ, three dots over the ف, for its v; موسى carries a short upright stroke over its final ى, and «ه» after the Hijri year 1345 and «م» after 1926 abbreviate the eras.
The 1962 reprint reproduces this page on its own title page (frame 005) and adds two lines in type.
